title: OL-20261115-22: Publication flip needs ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN route
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** daily lane sweep and any change to doctrine/publication.json
**Done check:** grep:foundation/publication.py::def flip
**Status:** open

All seven ultrastable repos stay as they are until a server-side route holding ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN runs publication --flip --apply. Default in effect: no change. A cloud session cannot change visibility.
